considered, not kept.concept: Host-side bus request and response as one transaction
considered, not kept.reason: The bus records are forwarded through reg_stage_inst without being stored, computed, or locally decided; only the distinct information on the non-record external bus is judged under the non-record bus exception.
The bus-handshake-copy rule bars pending because it only re-times, starts, ends, and qualifies the access already carried by the bus transaction.
The bus-handshake-copy rule bars locked because it copies the request lock bit and is read only to control the lifetime of that access.
